title: Mazungumzo ya Kimuktadha (Theme 9: Afya ya akili)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child names the setting as formal or informal by place, purpose and listener, then chooses language to fit, including on the phone.

floor.prerequisite: Uses official language at the clinic.
floor.question: Unamwelezaje daktari?

contexts: mental health (afya ya akili): talking to a counsellor

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child acts a formal phone call.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: ""Niaje, msee?" ni lugha ___." Kwa nini "rasmi" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Lugha rasmi ni ya heshima na ya viongozi. Lugha isiyo rasmi ni ya marafiki na nyumbani.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Chagua sentensi inayofaa unapozungumza na mwalimu mkuu." Kwa nini "Nipe ruhusa tu." si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kwa mwalimu, kiongozi au mkutano rasmi tunatumia maneno ya heshima.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Chagua sentensi inayofaa unapozungumza na rafiki uwanjani." Kwa nini "Naomba kibali cha kuanza mchezo." si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kwa rafiki au ndugu nyumbani, lugha ya kawaida inafaa. Lugha rasmi kupita kiasi inasikika ya ajabu.
Kwa simu rasmi: salimu, jitambulishe, eleza sababu, shukuru.

checks.question: Lugha rasmi au isiyo rasmi: "Mambo vipi bro?"
